text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
Thank you so much for giving me yesterday off...
choice_data_list: Despite that, you seem a bit tired...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Well, um... during the break, I was devoted to my saintly duties.
Things like campus beautification and consulting with fellow students on their worries...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I exerted myself a bit too much, as
my fatigue has not fully dissipated...
How shameful for a saint.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
However, I will not neglect today's duties.
I shall do my utmost as a Saintess!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Red Desire
wasn't able to rest very well...
